notes: This directory is the authoritative stable Linx ISA 0.58 profile aligned to PTO ISA 0.58.0.
PTO-ISA/pto-spec is the sole normative source for 474 scalar forms, 96 command forms, and 106 tile operations; pto-spec.lock.json freezes its exact commit and tree.
Linx retains its additive two-level vector extension; PTO reserves the six corresponding vector encodings to prevent future conflicts.
TEPL uses separate Mode and Function fields; the legacy TileOpcode and all legacy decode aliases are forbidden.
The exact tile inventory is 87 TEPL, 7 TMA, and 12 CUBE operations. Unlisted selectors and unassigned functions trap as illegal instructions.
S0 through S255 are absolute-index shared tile registers in a core-private bank shared by the core's four PEs.
C.B.IOS names shared-register sources and destinations; an optional B.IOT PE mask predicates fixed quarters, with zero acting as a NOP.
B.IOD remains reserved and old BSTART.PAR/TEPL encodings remain retired.
BSTART.TMA remains an encoding-family name, not a legal textual instruction.
